lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ xiūxi de shíhou zuò shénme?
lines.en: What do you do when you have time off?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 我喜欢游泳，也爱打篮球。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan yóuyǒng, yě ài dǎ lánqiú.
lines.en: I like swimming, and I love playing basketball.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Yóuyǒng? Wǒ yīdiǎnr yě bú huì.
lines.en: Swimming? I can't do it at all.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 真的吗？太好了！你每星期去几次？
lines.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Tài hǎo le! Nǐ měi xīngqī qù jǐ cì?
lines.en: Really? Great! How many times a week do you go?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Next to the school, it's very close.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 好，这个星期六我们一起去吧。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, zhège xīngqīliù wǒmen yīqǐ qù ba.
lines.en: OK, let's go together this Saturday.
